meta.title: Write path: forward, replicate, commit, apply

messages.label: Put(k, v) with kv-forwarded=1
messages.note: leader encodes the Command, appends it to its boltdb log (fsync)

messages.label: ack (persisted)
messages.note: majority persisted → committed; FSM.Apply: version+1, mod_index = entry index

cards.title: Durability before ack
items: An entry is acknowledged only after a majority has it on disk
The response carries the FSM result plus the entry's index and term

cards.title: Forwarding
items: A follower forwards once; the kv-forwarded tag stops a second hop
A leadership change mid-hop yields Unavailable NOT_APPLIED, never a silent retry

cards.title: Ordering
items: One goroutine applies committed entries in log order
Per-key version increments make CompareAndSwap deterministic
